2003 (c. 44), ss. 331, 336, Sch. 36 Pt. 3 para. 32; S.I. 2005/950, art. 2, Sch. 1; S.I. 2005/1817, art. 2
Confidentiality

17 Confidentiality of disclosed information.

(1) If the accused is given or allowed to inspect a document or other object under—
(a) section 3, 4, [F447A] , 14 or 15, or
(b) an order under section 8,
then, subject to subsections (2) to (4), he must not use or disclose it or any information
recorded in it.

(2) The accused may use or disclose the object or information—
(a) in connection with the proceedings for whose purposes he was given the object
or allowed to inspect it,
(b) with a view to the taking of further criminal proceedings (for instance, by way
of appeal) with regard to the matter giving rise to the proceedings mentioned
in paragraph (a), or
(c) in connection with the proceedings first mentioned in paragraph (b).
